items.title: 中國電動車巨頭轉進非洲 開拓「最後的增長市場」
items.title_en: China's Electric Vehicle Giants Expand into Africa, Tapping into the 'Last Major Growth Market'
paras: 面對國內需求放緩以及歐美市場日益升高的貿易壁壘，中國車企正調整戰略，將非洲視為全球汽車產業最後一個主要增長市場。
其中，中國最大的汽車出口商奇瑞汽車於 7 月收購了日產位於南非普利托利亞附近的 Rosslyn 工廠，計畫生產插電式混合動力車、純電動車及旗下的捷途 (Jetour) 品牌車型，象徵著中國車企從單純的整車出口，轉向更深度的「非洲製造」布局。
南非非營利組織「電動使命」執行董事 Hiten Parmar 表示，非洲已成為汽車市場的下一個前沿陣地。
據《美聯社》報導，這場轉型是為了應對歐美市場對中國製電動車築起的貿易牆。Parmar 指出，雖然非洲消費者一直以來都熱衷於購買二手車，但亞洲品牌的實惠價格讓更多人能夠負擔得起新車。
除了奇瑞外，北汽集團已在南非伊莉莎白港設有組裝廠，長城汽車也在當地具備組裝與零組件配送能力。這種「在地化生產」能有效規避進口關稅，降低售價，進而挑戰長期由歐、美、日品牌壟斷的非洲市場。
與此同時，非洲多國政府正積極推動綠色轉型。例如，衣索比亞已宣布禁止進口燃油車，並對本土組裝的電動車給予關稅優惠；南非則提供稅收減免與生產補助，吸引電動車與氫能車投資。此外，摩洛哥憑藉地理優勢與電池供應鏈潛力，正計畫建設非洲首座電池超級工廠。
Zero Carbon Analytics 能源轉型研究分析師 Nick Hedley 指出，非洲國家作為燃料淨進口國，推動電動車本土化生產不僅能創造就業，更能減少對外匯的消耗。
儘管前景看好，但基礎設施薄弱仍是最大障礙。若缺乏穩定且廉價的電力供應與完善的充電網絡，電動車的普及將難以實現。此外，將現有的燃油車生產線重組為電動車工廠極具挑戰，需要穩定的產業政策來維持投資者信心。
paras_en: Facing slowing domestic demand and rising trade barriers in Europe and the US, Chinese automakers are adjusting their strategies, viewing Africa as the last major growth market for the global automotive industry.

Chery, China's largest automobile exporter, acquired Nissan's Rosslyn factory near Pretoria, South Africa in July, planning to produce plug-in hybrid, pure electric, and Jetour brand vehicles, symbolizing Chinese automakers' shift from simple vehicle exports to deeper 'Made in Africa' layouts.
Hiten Parmar, executive director of the South African non-profit organization 'Electric Vehicle Mission', stated that Africa has become the next frontier for the automotive market.

According to a report by the Associated Press, this transformation is in response to the trade barriers erected by Europe and the US against Chinese-made electric vehicles. Parmar noted that although African consumers have traditionally preferred used cars, the affordability of Asian brands has made new cars more accessible to many.

In addition to Chery, BAIC Group has an assembly plant in Port Elizabeth, South Africa, and Great Wall Motors has assembly and component distribution capabilities in the country. This 'localized production' can effectively avoid import tariffs, reduce prices, and challenge the long-standing dominance of European, American, and Japanese brands in the African market.

Meanwhile, several African governments are actively promoting green transformation. For example, Ethiopia has announced a ban on fuel-powered vehicle imports and offers tariff preferences for locally assembled electric vehicles, while South Africa provides tax breaks and production subsidies to attract investment in electric and hydrogen vehicles. Morocco is also planning to build Africa's first battery super factory, leveraging its geographical advantages and battery supply chain potential.

Nick Hedley, an energy transition research analyst at Zero Carbon Analytics, pointed out that African countries, as net fuel importers, can create jobs and reduce foreign exchange consumption by promoting local electric vehicle production.

Despite the promising outlook, weak infrastructure remains the biggest obstacle. Without a stable and affordable power supply and a comprehensive charging network, the popularization of electric vehicles will be difficult to achieve. Furthermore, converting existing fuel-powered vehicle production lines to electric vehicle factories is extremely challenging and requires stable industrial policies to maintain investor confidence.

items.title: 記憶體長約擴散至二三線！長鑫拒蘋果降價、SanDisk最長鎖5年
items.title_en: Memory Long-Term Contracts Spread to Tier‑2 and Tier‑3 Suppliers! ChangXin Rejects Apple Price Cuts, SanDisk Locks in Up to 5 Years
paras: 全球記憶體晶片供需失衡持續加劇，長期供應協議（LTA）正從三星電子、SK 海力士與美光等主要記憶體大廠，進一步擴散至 SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 及中國長鑫儲存。
隨著客戶爭相提前鎖定產能，過去由買方主導的議價模式逐漸翻轉，供應商定價權明顯提升，長約期限、預付款與違約保障也同步強化，重塑記憶體產業的供應與定價邏輯。
記憶體供應緊張之下，長期供應協議已不再只是三星電子 (KR005930) 、SK 海力士 (000660KS) 與美光科技 (MU-US) 等一線大廠的現象，SanDisk 與長鑫儲存也加入這波長約浪潮，顯示客戶鎖定供應的需求正在向更多記憶體供應商擴散。
其中，長鑫儲存近期的議價能力尤其受到關注。為確保產品供應穩定，蘋果已測試並採用長鑫儲存產品，接受其「現成晶片」供貨模式。不過，當蘋果試圖進一步壓低 DRAM 採購價格時，卻遭到長鑫儲存拒絕。
韓國媒體《Digital Daily》報導，長鑫儲存堅持報價不得低於三星電子與 SK 海力士，甚至要求更高價格。背後原因在於華為、小米等中國本土企業已透過長期合約提前鎖定長鑫儲存產能，使其不必為爭取蘋果訂單而接受更苛刻的價格條件。
這也反映當前記憶體市場供需關係的變化。當產能成為稀缺資源，即使是採購規模龐大的客戶，也不再能像過去一樣單方面主導價格談判。
長約期限從 1 年拉長至 5 年
更明顯的結構性改變，則出現在合約期限。過去記憶體產業標準合約週期通常只有一年，買方掌握較大主動權，在供應寬鬆時壓低價格，供應吃緊時則提高採購量、鎖定供應，但如今這套模式正在被打破。
根據高盛針對三星、SK 海力士、美光與 SanDisk 四家廠商的長約條款比較，目前各廠合約期限普遍以 5 年為主，部分客戶選擇 3 年期，即使最短的合約期限，也已達到過去一年期產業慣例的 3 倍。
三星近期在財報電話會上更明確表示，公司 LTA 以 5 年為基礎期限，並設有逐年滾動續約機制，以確保合約持續有效。
三星聯席執行長 Kim Yong-hyun 先前指出，隨著 AI 投資擴張帶來供需不確定性，公司正從傳統短期協議轉向 3 至 5 年的多年期合約。
SK 海力士也指出，客戶對 LTA 的需求持續增加。目前 SK 海力士的前十大 LTA 客戶及關鍵客戶，合約期間大多為 5 年。
美光則已與 16 家策略客戶簽約，多數合約同樣為期 5 年，車用客戶則為 3 年。至於 SanDisk，8 家 LTA 客戶的加權平均合約期已超過 4 年，最長達五年。
4 家廠商同步將長約期限拉長，意味買方未來即使面臨需求或供需環境變化，調整採購策略的空間也將受到進一步壓縮。
預付款讓長約從承諾變成真金白銀
除了合約期限延長，本輪 LTA 另一項關鍵變化，是預付款機制全面落地。
過去記憶體長約的執行力相對有限，即使買方已經簽約，仍可能削減採購量、延後交貨甚至違約，而不必承擔太大的實質代價。
但這一輪供應商開始要求客戶提前投入大筆資金，使長期採購承諾真正轉化為具有財務約束力的合約。
從目前揭露的條款來看，美光預計將收到約 220 億美元現金定金及相關財務承諾；SanDisk 則已揭露超過 110 億美元的財務擔保，以及 165 億美元的客戶違約保護。
三星也表示，合約中包含大額預付款，目前已收取約四分之一。
對雲端服務商而言，若要確保 2028 年前取得足夠的 HBM 與 DRAM 供應，可能必須提前將數十億美元資金存入供應商帳上。這些資金一方面鎖定未來供貨，另一方面也將買方綁定在合約之中，大幅提高違約成本。
高盛因此將預付款機制視為「本輪 LTA 週期與歷輪最顯著的區別特徵」。
從 SanDisk 到長鑫儲存，長期供應協議向更多廠商擴散，加上合約期限拉長與預付款制度成形，顯示記憶體產業的供需權力結構正在改變，供應商的定價權與議價能力也隨之提升。
paras_en: Global memory chip supply‑demand imbalance continues to worsen, and long‑term supply agreements (LTAs) are expanding beyond major memory makers Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron to include SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) and China’s ChangXin Storage.

As customers race to lock in capacity early, the buyer‑driven bargaining model is gradually reversing, giving suppliers clear pricing power. LTA terms, upfront payments and breach protections are also being strengthened, reshaping the memory industry’s supply and pricing logic.

With memory supply tight, LTAs are no longer a phenomenon limited to first‑tier giants Samsung Electronics (KR005930), SK Hynix (000660KS) and Micron Technology (MU‑US). SanDisk and ChangXin Storage have joined this wave, showing that customer‑driven supply locking is spreading to more memory providers.

ChangXin Storage’s recent bargaining strength has drawn particular attention. To ensure stable product supply, Apple has tested and adopted ChangXin’s products, accepting its “ready‑die” supply model. However, when Apple tried to push DRAM purchase prices lower, ChangXin refused.

Korean media outlet Digital Daily reported that ChangXin insists its pricing not fall below Samsung and SK Hynix, even demanding higher prices. The reason is that Chinese firms such as Huawei and Xiaomi have already locked ChangXin capacity through long‑term contracts, allowing it to avoid conceding to harsher terms for Apple orders.

This also reflects a shift in the current memory market’s supply‑demand dynamics. When capacity becomes scarce, even large‑scale buyers can no longer unilaterally dominate price negotiations as they once did.
LTA durations have been stretched from 1 year to 5 years

A more obvious structural change appears in contract length. Historically, the memory industry’s standard contract cycle was typically one year, giving buyers the upper hand: they could push prices down when supply was ample and increase purchases or lock supply when it was tight. That model is now being broken.

According to Goldman Sachs’ comparison of LTA terms for Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron and SanDisk, most contracts now run for five years, with some customers opting for three‑year terms—still three times the previous industry norm of one‑year contracts.
Samsung recently clarified in its earnings call that its LTAs are based on a five‑year term with a rolling annual renewal mechanism to keep contracts continuously effective.

Samsung co‑CEO Kim Yong‑hyun previously noted that as AI investment expansion creates supply‑demand uncertainty, the company is shifting from traditional short‑term agreements to multi‑year contracts of three to five years.
SK Hynix also said demand for LTAs from customers continues to rise. Its top ten LTA customers and key accounts mostly have five‑year contract periods.

Micron has signed LTAs with 16 strategic customers, most for five years, while automotive customers have three‑year terms. For SanDisk, the weighted‑average LTA term across eight customers exceeds four years, with the longest reaching five years.
All four manufacturers extending LTA durations means that even if buyers face demand or market‑condition changes, their ability to adjust procurement strategies will be further compressed.
Up‑front payments turn LTAs from commitments into cash
Beyond longer terms, a key change in this round of LTAs is the full implementation of upfront‑payment mechanisms.

Historically, the enforceability of long‑term memory contracts was limited; even after signing, buyers could cut purchase volumes, delay deliveries or breach contracts without bearing substantial costs.
Now suppliers are demanding large upfront cash injections, converting long‑term purchase commitments into financially binding contracts.

Based on disclosed terms, Micron expects to receive about $22 billion in cash deposits and related financial commitments; SanDisk has disclosed over $11 billion in financial guarantees and $16.5 billion in customer breach protection.
Samsung also said its contracts include sizable upfront payments, having already collected roughly one‑quarter of the agreed amount.

For cloud service providers, securing enough HBM and DRAM supply before 2028 may require depositing tens of billions of dollars with suppliers in advance. This locks future supply while binding buyers to the contracts, dramatically raising breach costs.
Goldman Sachs therefore views the upfront‑payment mechanism as “the most distinctive feature of this LTA cycle compared with previous rounds.”

From SanDisk to ChangXin Storage, LTAs are spreading to more manufacturers. Combined with longer contract terms and the emergence of upfront‑payment structures, the memory industry’s supply‑demand power balance is shifting, enhancing suppliers’ pricing power and bargaining strength.

items.title: 車用透鏡與AI伺服器雙引擎發威 雷笛克光學Q3營運看好更上層樓
items.title_en: Laser Optics Sees Bright Future with AI Server and Automotive Lens Sales
paras: 光學透鏡大廠雷笛克光學(5230-TW)對2026年第三季營運樂觀看待，受惠人AI伺服器H系列於中國市場開始解禁並持續出貨，加上公司於B系列及Vera Rubin平台同步配合客戶開發精密散熱及結構件，隨著相關產品持續挹注，第三季營收與獲利可望更上層樓。
回顧2026年第二季營運狀況，雷笛克光學單季合併營收達3.53億元，季增16%、年增7%，創下近11年同期次高紀錄，第二季營業利益為424萬元，歸屬母公司業主淨利565萬元，每股稅後盈餘達0.1元，成功終結自2025年第一季以來連續五季虧損，營運順利重返獲利軌道。
雷笛克光學第二季受惠車用新案出貨放量與高附加價值產品比重提升，單季車用領域銷售比重自去年同期的46%拉升至52%，帶動第二季毛利率達27.6%，年增6.5個百分點，營業利益率與稅後淨利率亦同步精進至1.2%與1.5%，呈現三率三升的優異成績。
在車用佈局方面，雷笛克光學持續優化產品與接單結構，積極擴展矩陣式頭燈中的自適應遠近光燈等高階光學透鏡，由於車用產品驗證期長且技術門檻高，打入供應鏈後客戶黏著度極高，公司將持續深化與兩岸及歐美系一線車用供應鏈客戶的合作關係。
展望未來，雷笛克光學除穩固既有車用光學透鏡市場地位外，將持續推進高階車用新案量產，同時結合人工智慧伺服器精密散熱與結構件的新動能，透過產品組合優化與營運效率提升，落實長期營運綜效。
paras_en: Laser Optics (5230-TW) is optimistic about its third-quarter performance in 2026, thanks to the growing demand for its AI server H series in the Chinese market and the increasing sales of its B series and Vera Rubin platform products.

In the second quarter of 2026, Laser Optics reported a combined revenue of NT$353 million, a 16% increase from the previous quarter and a 7% increase from the same period last year, setting a new record for the company. The company's net income was NT$42.4 million, and its earnings per share were NT$0.1.

Laser Optics' second-quarter performance was driven by the increased sales of its automotive products, which accounted for 52% of its revenue, up from 46% in the same period last year. The company's gross margin was 27.6%, a 6.5% increase from the same period last year, and its operating margin and net profit margin were 1.2% and 1.5%, respectively.

In terms of its automotive business, Laser Optics is continuously optimizing its products and order structure, and expanding its matrix-style headlight products, including adaptive near and far light. The company is also deepening its cooperation with its customers in the automotive supply chain in Taiwan, the US, and Europe.

Looking ahead, Laser Optics plans to continue to solidify its position in the automotive lens market while pushing forward with the production of high-end automotive products. The company will also leverage its AI server products to develop new technologies and improve its operational efficiency.

items.title: 仍有望漲350%！大摩預測SpaceX股價衝擊600美元 但前提條件極為苛刻
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Predicts SpaceX Stock Price to Reach $600, But with Extremely Challenging Assumptions
paras: 摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)分析師Adam Jonas週二(11日)重申對SpaceX股票「增持」評等，基準目標價300美元，同時拋出震動市場的「牛市情景」。若一切順利，SpaceX可衝上600美元，對應估值高達8兆美元，將超越當前全球任何上市公司。SpaceX週二收在133.29美元，較6月IPO發行價135美元略低，市值約1.75兆美元。
要從133跳到600， Jonas關鍵假設極為苛刻：Starship完全可重複用火箭須高頻高效飛行，把軌道AI資料中心部署成本砍半；Starlink不能只做家用寬頻，要到2040年接入數億甚至數十億台AI機器人，每用戶平均收入(ARPU)拉到35美元。
32位受訪分析師平均預期SpaceX股價約227美元，區間從輝立證券75美元到雷蒙德詹姆斯800美元，晨星更冷靜預估：核心發射與Starlink業務價值僅約每股40美元，其餘估值幾乎全押在AI/軌道資料中心敘事上，即便自家「登月情景」154美元也只給7%機率。
質疑聲浪則聚焦兩點：一，Jonas在7月24日報告中曾自承，若股價僅100美元，市場等於完全沒給AI業務定價，如此600美元的大部分上行，來自目前仍大幅虧損、客戶可提前90天無懲罰退租的AI合約；二，SpaceX第二季資本支出184億美元、其中AI相關約158億，上半年燒錢285億美元，技術尚未完全驗證就把估值鎖在「一切順利」假設上，屬高風險貼現。
這場估值8兆美元設想的本質是把「火箭複用+星鏈機器人網路+軌道AI算力」三條尚未規模化的曲線疊加折現，基準300美元或許反映市場願意為執行力付溢價，但600美元更像一張寫給2040年的選擇權，而非當下可兌付的價格錨。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley analyst Adam Jonas reaffirmed his "buy" rating for SpaceX stock on Tuesday, setting a base price target of $300. He also presented a market-shaking "bull case" scenario. If everything goes smoothly, SpaceX could reach $600, corresponding to a valuation of $800 billion, surpassing any listed company globally. SpaceX closed at $133.29 on Tuesday, slightly lower than its IPO price of $135 in June, with a market value of approximately $175 billion.

To jump from $133 to $600, Jonas made extremely challenging assumptions: Starship must be able to launch repeatedly at a high frequency and efficiency, and the cost of deploying an orbital AI data center must be cut in half. Additionally, Starlink must not only provide home broadband but also connect billions or even tens of billions of AI robots by 2040, with an average revenue per user (ARPU) of $35.

Thirty-two analysts surveyed by Bloomberg expect SpaceX's stock price to be around $227, with a range from $75 by Credit Suisse to $800 by Raymond James. Morningstar is more conservative, estimating that the core launch and Starlink business value is around $40 per share, with the rest of the valuation largely dependent on the AI/Orbital Data Center narrative, even its "moonshot" scenario of $154 only gives a 7% probability.

Critics focus on two points: one, Jonas himself admitted in his July 24 report that if the stock price is only $100, the market is essentially giving no value to the AI business. The majority of the potential upside to $600 comes from AI contracts that are currently heavily loss-making and allow customers to cancel their subscriptions 90 days in advance without penalty. Two, SpaceX's capital expenditure in the second quarter was $18.4 billion, with approximately $15.8 billion related to AI, and the company burned $28.5 billion in the first half of the year, with the technology still unproven, it's a high-risk assumption to lock in valuation based on "everything going smoothly".

The $800 billion valuation scenario is essentially a combination of three unproven curves: rocket reuse, Starlink robot network, and orbital AI computing power. The base price of $300 may reflect the market's willingness to pay a premium for execution, but $600 is more like a call option for 2040, rather than a current price anchor that can be paid out.

items.title: Gogolook三率三升 Q2獲利創新高 上半年EPS達3.33元
items.title_en: Gogolook Achieves Record-High Q2 Profit, EPS Reaches 3.33 Yuan
paras: 信任科技服務商 Gogolook(6902-TW)今(12)日公布第二季財報，稅後純益5961萬元，每股純益(EPS)1.69元，創單季獲利新高紀錄，也大幅優於去年同期每股虧損 0.23 元，反映營收持續擴大且跨越關鍵規模，營運效率顯著提升，繳出「三率三升」佳績；累計上半年稅後純益1.18億元，EPS 3.33元。
Gogolook表示，隨著營收規模持續擴張，並導入 AI 提升營運效率成果顯著，營業利益率可望維持高檔，樂觀看下半年獲利將延續上半年的高水準，全年整體獲利可望大幅躍升創新高。
Gogolook進一步說明，旗下消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務同步擴張中，推升第二季合併營收 3.10 億元，年增28.4%，創單季新高。

paras_en: Gogolook (6902-TW) announced its second-quarter earnings on December 12, with a net profit of NT$59.61 million, EPS of NT$1.69, a record-high single-quarter profit, and significantly better than the net loss of NT$0.23 per share in the same period last year, reflecting continued revenue growth and crossing the critical scale, significant improvement in operating efficiency, and achieving "three rates three rises" performance.

Gogolook stated that with revenue scale continuing to expand and the introduction of AI to improve operating efficiency, the company expects to maintain a high profit margin, and is optimistic about the continuation of high profitability in the second half of the year, with a significant increase in annual profit.

Gogolook further explained that its three major businesses, consumer anti-scam, enterprise anti-scam, and financial technology services, are all expanding simultaneously, pushing the company's combined revenue to NT$310 million in the second quarter, up 28.4% year-over-year, a new single-quarter high.

Among them, the consumer anti-scam business accounted for 34% of revenue, reflecting the benefits of team-wide advertising price optimization; while subscription income benefited from overseas market expansion, the launch of a new multi-person subscription plan, and diversified payment channels from telecom operators, with a year-over-year increase of 12%, accounting for 29% of revenue; the enterprise anti-scam business saw a 59% year-over-year increase in revenue, accounting for 9% of revenue, with recent signing of multiple long-term contracts with government agencies and corporate clients, with sustained momentum expected; and financial technology services mainly reflected the rapid growth of JUJI, with a 28% year-over-year increase in revenue, accounting for 28% of revenue.

GOGOLOOK's second-quarter gross margin was 89.6%, up 1.8 percentage points year-over-year, and operating margin was 20.6%, with a year-over-year increase of 15.4 percentage points, with operating profit of NT$63.74 million, a new historical high, and a year-over-year growth rate of 412%.

Gogolook stated that it aims to achieve long-term growth performance better than the global industry average, and will continue to deepen the application of AI technology, innovate in personal security, enterprise anti-scam, and inclusive financial technology, and pursue continuous revenue and profit growth through maintaining excellent investment efficiency.

items.title: 榮成轉型為控股公司分割工紙及紙箱事業 暫訂明年1月完成
items.title_en: Rongsheng to Transform into Holding Company by Splitting Paper and Box Businesses, Targeting Completion in January 2027
paras: 榮成(1909-TW)今(12)日召開董事會，通過以分割方式轉型為投資控股公司議案，將台灣地區營運事業包括工業用紙事業以及紙箱事業相關營業，概括讓與給100%持股公司「榮成低碳紙箱股份有限公司」，榮成則轉型為控股公司，並更名為「榮成投資控股股份有限公司」，暫訂基準日為2027年1月4日。
榮成說明，分割事業方面，將按工業用紙與紙箱事業的整體營業價值新台幣60億元，以每股新台幣30元，換取榮成低碳紙箱公司新發行的普通股1股。分割完成後，榮成低碳紙箱公司將成為榮成投控旗下100%持有的子公司，專責承接台灣工紙與紙箱相關業務。
另外，原有的 L&C CO.,(BVI) LTD.及旗下公司負責中國業務、日本榮成及旗下公司負責日本及其他海外業務，集團形成區域分工三大子集團架構。
榮成進一步提到，未來榮成投控將負責集團整體策略規劃、資源配置及對外投資布局。有關業務分割及轉型投控公司案，將於10月1日召開股東臨時回討論決議，暫定基準日為2027年1月4日。
榮成指出，希望藉由此次重組轉型，未來在控股平台架構下，充分發揮管理效能，提升組織運作效率，旗下各核心事業體將可專注深耕於其領域，並擬積極透過策略投資、合資或併購方式，引進策略夥伴，強化自身核心優勢與營運動能。
paras_en: Rongsheng (1909-TW) held a board meeting today (12th) and passed a resolution to transform into an investment holding company through a split, transferring its Taiwan-based operating businesses, including industrial paper and box-related operations, to a 100% subsidiary company called Rongsheng Low-Carbon Box Co., Ltd. Rongsheng will then transform into a holding company and be renamed Rongsheng Investment Holding Co., Ltd. The target date is set for January 4, 2027.

Rongsheng explained that the split of businesses will be based on the total operating value of NT$6 billion for industrial paper and box businesses, with each share of Rongsheng worth NT$30, exchanged for one ordinary share of Rongsheng Low-Carbon Box Co. Ltd. After the split, Rongsheng Low-Carbon Box Co. will become a 100% subsidiary of Rongsheng Investment Holding Co. Ltd., responsible for handling Taiwan's paper and box-related businesses.

In addition, the original L&C CO., (BVI) LTD. and its subsidiaries will be responsible for China's business, while Rongsheng and its subsidiaries in Japan will be responsible for Japan and other overseas businesses, forming a three-tiered subsidiary structure with regional division of labor.

Rongsheng further stated that in the future, Rongsheng Investment Holding Co. will be responsible for the group's overall strategic planning, resource allocation, and external investment layout. The business split and transformation into a holding company will be discussed at a shareholders' extraordinary meeting on October 1, with a target date of January 4, 2027.

Rongsheng hopes to achieve a more efficient management and operational efficiency through this transformation, allowing its core businesses to focus on their respective fields and actively introduce strategic partners through strategic investments, joint ventures, or mergers and acquisitions to strengthen its core competitiveness and operational capabilities.

items.title: 川普媒體戰略轉向：削減多元業務 每月10萬美元賣「總統訊息」優先存取權
items.title_en: Trump Media Shifts Strategy: Cutting Diversified Businesses to Focus on Truth Social
paras: 川普媒體與科技集團 (Trump Media & Technology Group)(TMTG) 宣布重大的戰略調整。這家由美國總統川普創立的公司，在嘗試橫跨加密貨幣、線上博弈及核融合等多個領域後，決定放棄大部分多元化業務，重新聚焦於其社群平台 Truth Social。
根據周一 (10 日) 公布的財報，川普媒體在截至 6 月 30 日的第二季表現慘淡，虧損高達 2.38 億美元，是去年同期虧損額的十倍以上。雖然營收增長至 170 萬美元，但仍無法抵消龐大的支出。
這筆巨額虧損中很大一部分，來自於公司持有的比特幣等加密資產價值縮水所帶來的帳面損失。新任執行長麥格恩 (Kevin McGurn) 坦言，公司將進行「紀律性的選擇」，裁撤與媒體核心業務無關的投資。
為了提振營收，公司推出了一項名為「Truth API」的新服務，向華爾街高頻交易公司等機構出售「搶先獲取」川普貼文的權限。由於川普經常在該平台上發布影響市場的重大政策 (如關稅或外交局勢)，這些數據對交易者而言極具價值。
目前已有超過 10 家公司簽約，每家每月支付 6 萬至 10 萬美元。麥格恩預計，僅這項業務每年就能為公司帶來 700 萬至 1200 萬美元的收入，這相當於該公司去年全年營收的兩到三倍。除了交易員，公司還計畫將此服務擴展至新聞機構及大語言模型開發商。
然而，這項業務引發了嚴重的道德與法律質疑。民主黨人與政府監管機構批評這等同於「變相出售白宮存取權」，讓特定投資者利用總統的公開聲明謀取暴利。參議員華倫 (Elizabeth Warren) 等人已表態，若民主黨在中期選舉後取得國會主導權，將對此展開正式調查。
paras_en: Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG) announced a major strategic shift. The company, founded by former US President Donald Trump, has decided to abandon most of its diversified businesses and focus on its social media platform Truth Social after trying to expand into various areas such as cryptocurrencies, online gaming, and nuclear fusion.

According to the quarterly report released on Monday (10th), Trump Media's second-quarter performance was dismal, with a net loss of $238 million, more than ten times the loss of the same period last year. Although revenue grew to $1.7 million, it was not enough to offset the massive expenses.

A significant portion of this massive loss came from the decline in value of the company's holdings in cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, resulting in a book loss. New CEO Kevin McGurn said the company would make 'disciplined choices' and cut investments unrelated to its core media business.

To boost revenue, the company introduced a new service called 'Truth API,' which sells 'first access' to Trump's posts to institutions such as high-frequency trading companies on Wall Street. Since Trump frequently posts significant policy updates (such as tariffs or diplomatic situations) on the platform, this data is highly valuable to traders.

More than 10 companies have already signed up, each paying $600,000 to $1 million per month. McGurn expects this business alone to generate $7 million to $12 million in revenue per year, which is equivalent to two to three times the company's revenue last year. In addition to traders, the company plans to expand this service to news organizations and large language model developers.

However, this business has raised serious moral and legal concerns. Democrats and government regulatory agencies have criticized it as 'de facto selling access to the White House,' allowing specific investors to profit from Trump's public statements. Senators such as Elizabeth Warren have already stated that if the Democrats gain control of Congress after the midterm elections, they will launch a formal investigation.

items.title: 〈鴻海法說〉Q2純益季增2成 EPS4.27元 上半年每股賺7.84元均創同期高
items.title_en: Hon Hai Posts 20% Rise in Q2 Net Profit, EPS of NT$4.27
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(12)日召開法說並公告第二季財報，稅後純益 599.74 億元，季增 20%、年增 35%，每股純益4.27 元，創歷年同期新高；上半年稅後純益 1098.93億元，年增 27%、每股純益7.84 元，也是同期新高。
鴻海第二季營收 2.52兆元，季增 19%、年增 41%；毛利率 6.12%，季減 0.06 個百分點、年減 0.21 個百分點；營業利益 948.03 億元，季增 25%、年增 68%；營業利益率 3.75%，季增 0.18 個百分點、年增 0.60 個百分點；淨利率 2.37%，季增 0.01 個百分點、年減 0.10 個百分點。
鴻海上半年營收 4.64兆元，年增 35%、毛利率 6.15%，年減 0.08 個百分點、營業利益 1704.52億元，年增 65%、營業利益率 3.67%，年增 0.67 個百分點、淨利率 2.37%，年減 0.15 個百分點。
鴻海第二季營收季增、年增均強勁成長，表現優於預期；四大產品領域來看，雲端網路、電腦終端、雲端及其他等產品均強勁成長、消費智能產品則顯著成長。以營收比重來看，雲端網路51%、消費智能29%、電腦終端15%、元件及其他5%。
鴻海財務長黃德才說明，第二季及上半年雖然因為產品組合影響，導致毛利率略為下滑，但本業獲利成長仍高於營收增幅，顯示規模提升及獲利能力優化。
paras_en: Hon Hai (2317-TW) held a conference call and announced its second-quarter earnings report today, with a net profit of NT$59.974 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and 35% from the same period last year. The earnings per share (EPS) reached NT$4.27, a new high for the same period. For the first half of the year, the net profit reached NT$109.893 billion, up 27% from the same period last year, with EPS of NT$7.84, also a new high.

Hon Hai's second-quarter revenue reached NT$2.52 trillion, up 19% from the previous quarter and 41% from the same period last year. The gross margin was 6.12%, down 0.06 percentage points from the previous quarter and 0.21 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating income reached NT$94.803 billion, up 25% from the previous quarter and 68% from the same period last year. The operating margin was 3.75%, up 0.18 percentage points from the previous quarter and 0.60 percentage points from the same period last year. The net profit margin was 2.37%, up 0.01 percentage point from the previous quarter and down 0.10 percentage point from the same period last year.

Hon Hai's first-half revenue reached NT$4.64 trillion, up 35% from the same period last year. The gross margin was 6.15%, down 0.08 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating income reached NT$170.452 billion, up 65% from the same period last year. The operating margin was 3.67%, up 0.67 percentage points from the same period last year. The net profit margin was 2.37%, down 0.15 percentage points from the same period last year.

Hon Hai's second-quarter revenue grew strongly, exceeding expectations. Looking at the four major product categories, cloud network, computer terminals, cloud and other products all grew strongly, while consumer intelligent products showed significant growth. In terms of revenue proportion, cloud network accounted for 51%, consumer intelligent products accounted for 29%, computer terminals accounted for 15%, and components and other products accounted for 5%.

Hon Hai's CFO, Huang Decai, explained that although the second-quarter and first-half results were affected by product mix, the company's profitability still grew faster than revenue growth, indicating scale expansion and improved profitability.

items.title: 車用透鏡與AI伺服器雙引擎發威 雷笛克光學Q3營運看好更上層樓
items.title_en: Laser Optics Sees Bright Future with AI Server and Automotive Lens Sales
paras: 光學透鏡大廠雷笛克光學(5230-TW)對2026年第三季營運樂觀看待，受惠人AI伺服器H系列於中國市場開始解禁並持續出貨，加上公司於B系列及Vera Rubin平台同步配合客戶開發精密散熱及結構件，隨著相關產品持續挹注，第三季營收與獲利可望更上層樓。
回顧2026年第二季營運狀況，雷笛克光學單季合併營收達3.53億元，季增16%、年增7%，創下近11年同期次高紀錄，第二季營業利益為424萬元，歸屬母公司業主淨利565萬元，每股稅後盈餘達0.1元，成功終結自2025年第一季以來連續五季虧損，營運順利重返獲利軌道。
雷笛克光學第二季受惠車用新案出貨放量與高附加價值產品比重提升，單季車用領域銷售比重自去年同期的46%拉升至52%，帶動第二季毛利率達27.6%，年增6.5個百分點，營業利益率與稅後淨利率亦同步精進至1.2%與1.5%，呈現三率三升的優異成績。
在車用佈局方面，雷笛克光學持續優化產品與接單結構，積極擴展矩陣式頭燈中的自適應遠近光燈等高階光學透鏡，由於車用產品驗證期長且技術門檻高，打入供應鏈後客戶黏著度極高，公司將持續深化與兩岸及歐美系一線車用供應鏈客戶的合作關係。
展望未來，雷笛克光學除穩固既有車用光學透鏡市場地位外，將持續推進高階車用新案量產，同時結合人工智慧伺服器精密散熱與結構件的新動能，透過產品組合優化與營運效率提升，落實長期營運綜效。
paras_en: Laser Optics (5230-TW) is optimistic about its third-quarter performance in 2026, thanks to the growing demand for its AI server H series in the Chinese market and the increasing sales of its B series and Vera Rubin platform products.

In the second quarter of 2026, Laser Optics reported a combined revenue of NT$353 million, a 16% increase from the previous quarter and a 7% increase from the same period last year, setting a new record for the company. The company's net income was NT$42.4 million, and its earnings per share were NT$0.1.

Laser Optics' second-quarter performance was driven by the increased sales of its automotive products, which accounted for 52% of its revenue, up from 46% in the same period last year. The company's gross margin was 27.6%, a 6.5% increase from the same period last year, and its operating margin and net profit margin were 1.2% and 1.5%, respectively.

In terms of its automotive business, Laser Optics is continuously optimizing its products and order structure, and expanding its matrix-style headlight products, including adaptive near and far light. The company is also deepening its cooperation with its customers in the automotive supply chain in Taiwan, the US, and Europe.

Looking ahead, Laser Optics plans to continue to solidify its position in the automotive lens market while pushing forward with the production of high-end automotive products. The company will also leverage its AI server products to develop new technologies and improve its operational efficiency.

Gogolook further explained that its three major businesses, consumer anti-scam, enterprise anti-scam, and financial technology services, are all expanding simultaneously, pushing the company's combined revenue to NT$310 million in the second quarter, up 28.4% year-over-year, a new single-quarter high.

Among them, the consumer anti-scam business accounted for 34% of revenue, reflecting the benefits of team-wide advertising price optimization; while subscription income benefited from overseas market expansion, the launch of a new multi-person subscription plan, and diversified payment channels from telecom operators, with a year-over-year increase of 12%, accounting for 29% of revenue; the enterprise anti-scam business saw a 59% year-over-year increase in revenue, accounting for 9% of revenue, with recent signing of multiple long-term contracts with government agencies and corporate clients, with sustained momentum expected; and financial technology services mainly reflected the rapid growth of JUJI, with a 28% year-over-year increase in revenue, accounting for 28% of revenue.

GOGOLOOK's second-quarter gross margin was 89.6%, up 1.8 percentage points year-over-year, and operating margin was 20.6%, with a year-over-year increase of 15.4 percentage points, with operating profit of NT$63.74 million, a new historical high, and a year-over-year growth rate of 412%.

Gogolook stated that it aims to achieve long-term growth performance better than the global industry average, and will continue to deepen the application of AI technology, innovate in personal security, enterprise anti-scam, and inclusive financial technology, and pursue continuous revenue and profit growth through maintaining excellent investment efficiency.

items.title: 榮成轉型為控股公司分割工紙及紙箱事業 暫訂明年1月完成
items.title_en: Rongsheng to Transform into Holding Company by Splitting Paper and Box Businesses, Targeting Completion in January 2027
paras: 榮成(1909-TW)今(12)日召開董事會，通過以分割方式轉型為投資控股公司議案，將台灣地區營運事業包括工業用紙事業以及紙箱事業相關營業，概括讓與給100%持股公司「榮成低碳紙箱股份有限公司」，榮成則轉型為控股公司，並更名為「榮成投資控股股份有限公司」，暫訂基準日為2027年1月4日。
榮成說明，分割事業方面，將按工業用紙與紙箱事業的整體營業價值新台幣60億元，以每股新台幣30元，換取榮成低碳紙箱公司新發行的普通股1股。分割完成後，榮成低碳紙箱公司將成為榮成投控旗下100%持有的子公司，專責承接台灣工紙與紙箱相關業務。
另外，原有的 L&C CO.,(BVI) LTD.及旗下公司負責中國業務、日本榮成及旗下公司負責日本及其他海外業務，集團形成區域分工三大子集團架構。
榮成進一步提到，未來榮成投控將負責集團整體策略規劃、資源配置及對外投資布局。有關業務分割及轉型投控公司案，將於10月1日召開股東臨時回討論決議，暫定基準日為2027年1月4日。
榮成指出，希望藉由此次重組轉型，未來在控股平台架構下，充分發揮管理效能，提升組織運作效率，旗下各核心事業體將可專注深耕於其領域，並擬積極透過策略投資、合資或併購方式，引進策略夥伴，強化自身核心優勢與營運動能。
paras_en: Rongsheng (1909-TW) held a board meeting today (12th) and passed a resolution to transform into an investment holding company through a split, transferring its Taiwan-based operating businesses, including industrial paper and box-related operations, to a 100% subsidiary company called Rongsheng Low-Carbon Box Co., Ltd. Rongsheng will then transform into a holding company and be renamed Rongsheng Investment Holding Co., Ltd. The target date is set for January 4, 2027.

Rongsheng explained that the split of businesses will be based on the total operating value of NT$6 billion for industrial paper and box businesses, with each share of Rongsheng worth NT$30, exchanged for one ordinary share of Rongsheng Low-Carbon Box Co. Ltd. After the split, Rongsheng Low-Carbon Box Co. will become a 100% subsidiary of Rongsheng Investment Holding Co. Ltd., responsible for handling Taiwan's paper and box-related businesses.

In addition, the original L&C CO., (BVI) LTD. and its subsidiaries will be responsible for China's business, while Rongsheng and its subsidiaries in Japan will be responsible for Japan and other overseas businesses, forming a three-tiered subsidiary structure with regional division of labor.

Rongsheng further stated that in the future, Rongsheng Investment Holding Co. will be responsible for the group's overall strategic planning, resource allocation, and external investment layout. The business split and transformation into a holding company will be discussed at a shareholders' extraordinary meeting on October 1, with a target date of January 4, 2027.

Rongsheng hopes to achieve a more efficient management and operational efficiency through this transformation, allowing its core businesses to focus on their respective fields and actively introduce strategic partners through strategic investments, joint ventures, or mergers and acquisitions to strengthen its core competitiveness and operational capabilities.

items.title: 〈鴻海法說〉Q2純益季增2成 EPS4.27元 上半年每股賺7.84元均創同期高
items.title_en: Hon Hai Posts 20% Rise in Q2 Net Profit, EPS of NT$4.27
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(12)日召開法說並公告第二季財報，稅後純益 599.74 億元，季增 20%、年增 35%，每股純益4.27 元，創歷年同期新高；上半年稅後純益 1098.93億元，年增 27%、每股純益7.84 元，也是同期新高。
鴻海第二季營收 2.52兆元，季增 19%、年增 41%；毛利率 6.12%，季減 0.06 個百分點、年減 0.21 個百分點；營業利益 948.03 億元，季增 25%、年增 68%；營業利益率 3.75%，季增 0.18 個百分點、年增 0.60 個百分點；淨利率 2.37%，季增 0.01 個百分點、年減 0.10 個百分點。
鴻海上半年營收 4.64兆元，年增 35%、毛利率 6.15%，年減 0.08 個百分點、營業利益 1704.52億元，年增 65%、營業利益率 3.67%，年增 0.67 個百分點、淨利率 2.37%，年減 0.15 個百分點。
鴻海第二季營收季增、年增均強勁成長，表現優於預期；四大產品領域來看，雲端網路、電腦終端、雲端及其他等產品均強勁成長、消費智能產品則顯著成長。以營收比重來看，雲端網路51%、消費智能29%、電腦終端15%、元件及其他5%。
鴻海財務長黃德才說明，第二季及上半年雖然因為產品組合影響，導致毛利率略為下滑，但本業獲利成長仍高於營收增幅，顯示規模提升及獲利能力優化。
paras_en: Hon Hai (2317-TW) held a conference call and announced its second-quarter earnings report today, with a net profit of NT$59.974 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and 35% from the same period last year. The earnings per share (EPS) reached NT$4.27, a new high for the same period. For the first half of the year, the net profit reached NT$109.893 billion, up 27% from the same period last year, with EPS of NT$7.84, also a new high.

Hon Hai's second-quarter revenue reached NT$2.52 trillion, up 19% from the previous quarter and 41% from the same period last year. The gross margin was 6.12%, down 0.06 percentage points from the previous quarter and 0.21 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating income reached NT$94.803 billion, up 25% from the previous quarter and 68% from the same period last year. The operating margin was 3.75%, up 0.18 percentage points from the previous quarter and 0.60 percentage points from the same period last year. The net profit margin was 2.37%, up 0.01 percentage point from the previous quarter and down 0.10 percentage point from the same period last year.

Hon Hai's first-half revenue reached NT$4.64 trillion, up 35% from the same period last year. The gross margin was 6.15%, down 0.08 percentage points from the same period last year. Operating income reached NT$170.452 billion, up 65% from the same period last year. The operating margin was 3.67%, up 0.67 percentage points from the same period last year. The net profit margin was 2.37%, down 0.15 percentage points from the same period last year.

Hon Hai's second-quarter revenue grew strongly, exceeding expectations. Looking at the four major product categories, cloud network, computer terminals, cloud and other products all grew strongly, while consumer intelligent products showed significant growth. In terms of revenue proportion, cloud network accounted for 51%, consumer intelligent products accounted for 29%, computer terminals accounted for 15%, and components and other products accounted for 5%.

Hon Hai's CFO, Huang Decai, explained that although the second-quarter and first-half results were affected by product mix, the company's profitability still grew faster than revenue growth, indicating scale expansion and improved profitability.

items.title: 公公併恐引人才逃亡潮？官、公股經理年薪差150萬！董瑞斌拋合併成功3要件
items.title_en: Government-Controlled Banks' Merger May Trigger Talent Exodus: Officials and Public-Private Sector Managers' Salaries Differ by NT$1.5 Million
paras: 立法院今（12）日上午舉辦「泛公股金融機構合併之策略與計畫」公聽會，聚焦金融整併後的勞工權益與薪資制度。會中多位工會代表與行庫董座一致指出，國營行庫、泛公股與民營行庫間巨大的薪資福利落差，已成為當前公公併或公民併最難跨越的門檻，若將民營或泛公股併入國營體系，恐怕會引發人才逃亡潮。為了安定人心，兆豐金控 (2886-TW) 董事長暨銀行公會理事長董瑞斌拋出合併成功 3 要件，強調整併必須能達到一加一大於二的綜效，並重視企業文化融合與員工權益保障。
針對國營行庫與泛公股間的不平等待遇，臺灣銀行工會理事長林政潭於會中揭露，臺銀經理的年度所得比其他泛公股行庫經理少了約 150 萬元以上。此外，泛公股行庫可提撥 1% 至 8% 盈餘作為員工酬勞，但臺銀員工即便績效卓著也無法分享盈餘。臺銀在員工福利信託及主管加給上均付之闕如，導致人才加速外流。
臺灣金控董事長凌忠嫄對此深有感觸，她指出臺銀身為 100% 國營，受限於《公務員服務法》，經營績效無法與員工福利掛鉤。凌忠源直言，由於薪資與福利遠低於其他行庫，導致「沒人要跟我們併，我們想併別人，別人也不想併給我們」，整套制度若不改革，公公併將難有進展。
土地銀行董事長何英明也提出預警，若將民營或泛公股體系併入國營體系，由於薪資落差極大，如國票金控高階主管薪水可能是土銀的 6 至 7 倍，極可能導致人才大量流失，損害整併後的經營綜效。
第一銀行工會理事長陳正雄則強調，整併的首要條件是穩定人心，不能將裁員、減薪或降低勞動條件視為產出效益的手段。全金聯理事長鍾馥聯等工會代表也一致要求，併購過程必須公開透明，廢除《勞基法》第 20 條中新舊雇主商定留用的權限，改為概括承受所有員工的勞動條件。
兆豐金董座暨銀行公會理事長董瑞斌，提出合併成功的 3 要件：首先是強調合併的實質綜效，核心問題在於是否能達到一加一大於二甚至是發揮大於三的效果，必須嚴肅評估是否能提升競爭力，而不僅是帳面資產的擴大；其次是重視企業文化與員工安置，必須妥善處理不同行庫間的文化衝突、受僱人權益安置與客戶權益保障；第三則是尊重財政部政策並依法執行，若政府正式制定整併政策，身為公股一員會帶領團隊排除困難按政策執行。
針對工會對於提升員工福利的訴求，財政部長莊翠雲在會中給予具體承諾，宣布國營金融事業的生育補助將全面提升至每胎 10 萬元，若各行庫原有的保險或相關預算補貼不足 10 萬元，差額將由財政部的人口對策相關項目補足。莊翠雲表示，財政部支持提升國營金融事業待遇與福利，並已向行政院提報相關需求，希望能透過修法或行政手段讓國營行庫落實企業化經營原則。
paras_en: The Legislative Yuan held a public hearing on 'Strategies and Plans for the Merger of Financial Institutions with Public-Private Ownership' on December 12, focusing on labor rights and salary systems after financial consolidation. Representatives from various labor unions and bank presidents agreed that the huge salary and welfare gap between government-controlled banks, public-private banks, and private banks has become the biggest obstacle to the merger of government-controlled banks or public-private banks. If private or public-private banks are merged into the government-controlled system, it may trigger a talent exodus. To calm the nerves, Fubon Financial Holding (2886-TW) Chairman and Bankers Association Chairman Dong Rui-bin proposed three conditions for a successful merger, emphasizing that the merger must achieve a synergy effect of more than one plus one, and prioritizing corporate culture integration and employee welfare protection.

In response to the unequal treatment between government-controlled banks and public-private banks, Taiwan Bank Workers' Union Chairman Lin Zhengtan revealed at the hearing that Taiwan Bank managers' annual income is less than NT$1.5 million less than that of other public-private bank managers. In addition, public-private banks can allocate 1% to 8% of their profits as employee compensation, but Taiwan Bank employees, even if they have excellent performance, cannot share in the profits. Taiwan Bank has not paid employee welfare trust and managerial bonuses, leading to a rapid outflow of talent.

Taiwan Financial Holding Chairman Ling Zhongyan was deeply moved by this and pointed out that Taiwan Bank, as a 100% government-controlled bank, is limited by the 'Civil Service Act' and cannot link its operating performance with employee welfare. Ling Zhongyan said that due to the huge gap in salaries and welfare, 'no one wants to merge with us, and we want to merge with others, but others don't want to merge with us.' The entire system will not be reformed, making it difficult for government-controlled banks to merge.

Land Bank Chairman He Yingming also warned that if private or public-private banks are merged into the government-controlled system, due to the huge salary gap, such as the high-level managers of China Development Financial (2881-TW) may earn 6 to 7 times that of Land Bank, it is likely to lead to a large-scale talent exodus, harming the overall operating efficiency after the merger.

First Bank Workers' Union Chairman Chen Zhengxiong emphasized that the primary condition for the merger is to stabilize the nerves, and not to use layoffs, salary cuts, or reduced labor conditions as a means of increasing productivity. Full Gold Union Chairman Zhong Fuliang and other union representatives also unanimously demanded that the merger process must be transparent and open, and abolish Article 20 of the Labor Standards Act, which allows new and old employers to agree on the retention of employees, and replace it with a general acceptance of all employees' labor conditions.

Fubon Financial Holding Chairman and Bankers Association Chairman Dong Rui-bin proposed three conditions for a successful merger: first, emphasizing the substantive synergy effect, the core issue is whether it can achieve an effect of more than one plus one, or even a synergy effect of more than three, and must seriously evaluate whether it can improve competitiveness, rather than just expanding the face value of assets; second, prioritizing corporate culture integration and employee placement, and must properly handle the cultural conflicts between different banks, employee rights protection, and customer rights protection; third, respecting the Ministry of Finance's policy and implementing it in accordance with the law, if the government formally establishes a merger policy, as a public stockholder, it will lead the team to overcome difficulties and implement the policy.

In response to the union's demand for improving employee welfare, Finance Minister Zhu Cuilan made a specific commitment at the hearing, announcing that the birth allowance for government-controlled financial institutions will be fully increased to NT$1 million per child, and if the existing insurance or related budget subsidies of each bank are less than NT$1 million, the difference will be supplemented by the Ministry of Finance's population strategy-related projects. Zhu Cuilan said that the Ministry of Finance supports improving the treatment and welfare of government-controlled financial institutions and has submitted related demands to the Executive Yuan, hoping to achieve this through legislative or administrative means and let government-controlled banks implement the principle of corporate operation.

items.title: 台股站穩4萬5關 三大法人連三日同站多方買超225.22億元
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Holds Steady Above 45,000 Points
paras: 台股今 (12) 日在台積電、鴻海等權值股支撐下，以及伺服器 ODM、ABF 載板及光通訊族群，矽晶圓股等族群集體走強震，指數最高來到 45478 點，全日站穩 45000 點。終場收 45518.07 點，上漲 397.35 點，日 K 線連三紅，成交量 8587.32 億元；三大法人合計買超281.79億元。
觀察三大法人今天籌碼動向，外資買超110.21億；自營商買超87.01億元；投信買超28.01億元，三大法人合計買超225.22億元。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market today (12) rose to 45,478 points, supported by leading stocks such as Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Hon Hai Precision Industry (鴻海) and server ODM, ABF loading board and optical communication groups, and silicon wafer stocks. The index closed at 45,518.07 points, up 397.35 points, with a daily K line that has been red for three consecutive days. The trading volume was 858.732 billion. Institutional investors bought a total of NT$ 28.179 billion.

Institutional investors' buying power today was led by foreign investors, who bought NT$ 11.021 billion, followed by self-operating investors, who bought NT$ 8.701 billion, and investment trusts, who bought NT$ 2.801 billion. The total buying power of institutional investors was NT$ 22.522 billion.

items.title: 〈SEMICON〉SEMI偕測試與量測產業首度發聲 提出三大訴求
items.title_en: SEMI Calls for Government Support for Taiwan's Testing and Measurement Industry
paras: SEMICON Taiwan 即將在 9 月初登場，今 (12) 日舉辦先行論壇，SEMI 全球行銷長暨台灣區總裁曹世綸表示，台灣在先進製程與先進封裝已具領先優勢，每一次技術突破，都有賴產業鏈協同創新，而測試與量測已成為決定良率、成本與量產效率的關鍵，因此希望提供政府三大建言，包含專項政策支持、人才培育、產業共用先進測試設備平台，期盼政府進一步將測試量測納入策略布局，共同把握 AI 帶來的產業契機。
SEMI 指出，台灣擁有世界級的供應鏈整合與量產實力，下一步更需要產業與政府攜手，讓這項優勢持續深化並被全球看見。SEMI 將持續扮演產業連結者，凝聚共識、搭建對話平台，攜手產業布局未來、掌握 AI 時代的新機會。
SEMI 表示，AI 晶片供給關鍵不只在晶圓產能，更在於先進封裝、測試與量測能力能否同步跟上。隨著製程持續微縮、晶片與封裝架構日益複雜，測試不僅要驗證功能與效能是否符合要求，量測更需精準掌握製程參數與微小偏差。由於 AI 晶片價值與複雜度持續攀升，也讓測試與量測從幕後支援走向前台，成為先進製程中左右良率、效能與量產速度的關鍵環節。
為此，SEMI 國際半導體產業協會首度舉辦「AI 時代半導體測試與量測產業洞察暨倡議記者會」，由 SEMI 全球行銷長暨台灣區總裁曹世綸主持，並邀請致茂 (2360-TW) 執行長兼總經理暨 SEMI 檢測與計量委員會主席曾一士、京元電 (2449-TW) 總經理張高薰，分別從量測設備與測試服務角度分享產業觀察，現場並集結逾 20 位產業代表共同與會。
SEMI 於會前針對橫跨 IC 設計、晶圓製造、測試服務、量檢測設備等半導體全產業鏈的企業進行問卷調查。結果顯示，業界對於專項政策、學程接軌測試人才、共用先進測試設備三大方向已形成高度一致的共識，並期盼政府進一步將測試量測納入策略布局，共同把握 AI 帶來的產業契機。
測試與量測的價值重估，正反映在市場成長曲線上。根據 SEMI 預測，全球半導體設備銷售額將由 2025 年的 1,350 億美元增至 2028 年近 2,300 億美元；其中測試設備成長尤為強勁，2026 年銷售額預估大增 31% 至 153 億美元，2028 年更將進一步攀升至 208 億美元。台灣市場同樣展現成長動能。
經濟部統計處最新數據顯示，去年量測產業產值達新台幣 1,936 億元、創歷史新高，今年前 5 個月更年增 32.8%。這波成長動能主要來自先進邏輯、HBM 與高效能運算推升測試強度，帶動記憶體測試、系統級測試 (SLT)、老化測試與可靠度篩選的需求持續升溫。
完整且高度整合的半導體產業聚落，為測試與量測業者帶來供應鏈協作、量產效率與快速應變的優勢。SEMI 問卷顯示，相較美、日、韓、歐，業者高度認同台灣在與晶圓廠、封測廠緊密整合 (96.4%)、量產測試效率與成本控制 (71.4%)，以及快速客製化與交期彈性 (67.9%) 等面向的競爭力，共同形塑出「快速、整合、可靠」的世界級定位。
然而，面對 AI 帶來的新一波成長機會，產業也正尋求進一步升級。調查顯示，相較三年前，國際標準參與的提升幅度仍相對有限，業界也期待持續深化研發與原創技術能力；逾 4 成業者 (42.3%) 期待政府協助參與國際標準組織。展望下一階段，台灣除了持續強化前瞻技術研發，更須擴大國際標準的參與與影響力，從世界級供應鏈夥伴，進一步邁向下一代測試與量測技術與標準的定義者。

SEMI 調查顯示，AI 已成為測試與量測業務的主要成長動能，逾 9 成業者預期相關業務將於未來三年持續成長。隨著 AI 晶片對效能的要求提高，業界對量測精度與測試速度的要求同步大幅提升，測試角色也從後段品管向前段研發延伸，半數受訪者認為測試需更早介入設計與可製造性驗證 (DFT/DFM) 流程。在技術布局上，業者優先方向一致，先進封裝測試 (CoWoS/SoIC) 與光電量測 (矽光子) 分居前兩大重點。
paras_en: SEMI Taiwan, a leading trade association for the semiconductor industry, is set to debut in September with a pre-forum event on August 12. SEMI's global marketing vice president and Taiwan president, Cao Shilun, emphasized that Taiwan has a leading edge in advanced process and packaging, and that every technological breakthrough relies on industry chain collaboration and innovation. Testing and measurement have become critical in determining yield, cost, and production efficiency, and SEMI hopes to provide the government with three key recommendations: specialized policy support, talent cultivation, and a shared advanced testing equipment platform. SEMI hopes the government will further integrate testing and measurement into its strategic layout and seize the opportunities brought by AI.

SEMI pointed out that Taiwan has a world-class supply chain integration and production capacity. The next step is for the industry and government to work together to deepen this advantage and make it visible to the world. SEMI will continue to play a role in connecting the industry, building consensus, and creating a dialogue platform, and working together to layout the future and grasp the opportunities of the AI era.

SEMI noted that the key to AI chip supply is not just in wafer capacity, but also in advanced packaging, testing, and measurement capabilities. As processes continue to shrink and chip and packaging architectures become increasingly complex, testing must not only verify functionality and performance, but also accurately grasp process parameters and tiny deviations. With AI chip values and complexity continuing to rise, testing and measurement have moved from behind-the-scenes support to the forefront, becoming a critical factor in determining yield, performance, and production speed in advanced processes.

To this end, SEMI, the international semiconductor industry association, held its first "AI Era Semiconductor Testing and Measurement Industry Insights and Advocacy Press Conference". SEMI's global marketing vice president and Taiwan president, Cao Shilun, hosted the event, and invited Cheng Ming, CEO and general manager of Zhen Yi (2360-TW), and Zhang Gaohun, general manager of Jing Yuan (2449-TW), to share industry observations from the perspectives of measurement equipment and testing services. Over 20 industry representatives attended the event.

Before the conference, SEMI conducted a survey of companies across the IC design, wafer manufacturing, testing services, and inspection equipment industries. The results showed that the industry has formed a high degree of consensus on three key areas: specialized policies, talent cultivation, and shared advanced testing equipment. The industry hopes the government will further integrate testing and measurement into its strategic layout and seize the opportunities brought by AI.

The value of testing and measurement is being reevaluated, reflected in the market growth curve. According to SEMI's predictions, global semiconductor equipment sales will increase from $135 billion in 2025 to nearly $230 billion in 2028. Among them, testing equipment growth is particularly strong, with sales expected to increase by 31% to $15.3 billion in 2026 and further increase to $20.8 billion in 2028. The Taiwanese market also shows growth momentum.

According to the latest data from the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the testing industry's production value reached NT$193.6 billion last year, a new high. In the first five months of this year, the growth rate was 32.8%. This growth momentum is mainly driven by advanced logic, HBM, and high-performance computing, which have increased testing intensity and driven the demand for memory testing, system-level testing (SLT), aging testing, and reliability screening.

A complete and highly integrated semiconductor industry cluster brings supply chain collaboration, production efficiency, and rapid response advantages to testing and measurement companies. SEMI's survey shows that compared to the US, Japan, South Korea, and Europe, companies highly recognize Taiwan's competitiveness in tight integration with wafer factories and packaging factories (96.4%), production testing efficiency and cost control (71.4%), and rapid customization and delivery flexibility (67.9%), shaping a "fast, integrated, and reliable" world-class position.

However, the industry is seeking further upgrading to face the new wave of growth opportunities brought by AI. The survey shows that the international standard participation rate has increased relatively little compared to three years ago, and the industry expects continued deepening of R&D and original technology capabilities. Over 40% of companies (42.3%) expect government assistance in participating in international standard organizations. Looking ahead to the next stage, Taiwan needs to continue to strengthen forward-looking technology R&D and expand international standard participation and influence, from world-class supply chain partners to the definition of next-generation testing and measurement technology and standards.

SEMI's survey shows that AI has become the main growth driver for testing and measurement businesses, with over 90% of companies expecting related businesses to continue growing over the next three years. As AI chips require higher performance, the industry's requirements for measurement accuracy and testing speed have increased significantly, and the testing role has extended from the back-end quality control to the front-end R&D. Half of the respondents believe that testing needs to intervene earlier in the design and manufacturability verification (DFT/DFM) process. In terms of technical layout, companies have a consistent priority direction, with advanced packaging testing (CoWoS/SoIC) and optical measurement (silicon photonics) ranking as the top two priorities.

items.title: 中砂(1560)盈餘成長不只靠投片量 台積電A16增加CMP步驟、高階耗材價值提升
items.title_en: TSMC's A16 Process Boosts CMP Demand for Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (1560-TW)
paras: 2026年08月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 隨台積電先進製程從 N2世代持續朝具備背面供電技術的 A16，以及下一世代 A14平台推進，製程複雜度提高正為半導體耗材供應商帶來新的成長機會。中砂(1560-TW)在最新法說會表示，一般 N2在未導入晶背供電時，這一段製程約有50 幾道，導入 A16晶背供電後則增加至70 幾道，顯示先進製程對 CMP相關耗材的需求，除了受到晶圓投片量帶動之外，另一個越來越重要的驅動力，也與單片晶圓所需的製程步驟增加有關。
所以市場在評估中砂DBU鑽石碟業務時（Diamond Business Unit），除了觀察台積電先進製程產能與晶圓投片量，單片晶圓需要經歷多少 CMP製程，也將成為影響 Diamond Disk需求的重要因素。
CMP是晶圓製造中的重要研磨製程，主要利用研磨墊搭配化學研磨液，把晶圓表面磨平。不過研磨墊使用一段時間後，表面會逐漸堆積研磨殘留物，影響研磨效果，因此必須定期進行修整。中砂主要供應的 Diamond Disk，就是負責「整理研磨墊」的耗材，透過表面的鑽石顆粒重新修整研磨墊，使其維持穩定的研磨能力。
也就是說，Diamond Disk雖然不直接接觸晶圓進行研磨，卻是維持 CMP製程穩定運作的重要耗材；當先進製程需要更多 CMP步驟，研磨墊使用頻率提高，也會增加 Diamond Disk的使用需求。
中砂表示，若以製程步驟來看，一般 N2沒有晶背供電時約有「50 幾道」，加入 A16晶背供電後增加至「70 幾道」。CMP步驟增加不一定會與 Diamond Disk用量呈等比例成長，但概念不變，隨先進製程持續演進，單片晶圓所需處理的製程複雜度正在提高。
這也使中砂的成長動能不再單純取決於晶圓投片數量。即使晶圓投片量增幅有限，只要每片晶圓需要更多 CMP步驟，Diamond Disk等耗材的使用需求仍可能隨之增加。
對投資人而言，影響中砂 Diamond Disk盈餘成長的主要變數包括晶圓投片量、單片晶圓 CMP製程複雜度、Diamond Disk實際耗用強度，以及中砂在各製程節點的市占率。其中，晶圓投片量與 CMP製程複雜度正隨先進製程量產同步提升。
中砂第二季2奈米與1.6奈米相關營收較第一季成長約 84 %，公司表示，主要受到客戶新廠產能陸續增加帶動。以第二季來看，2奈米營收占比已達 14 %，與3奈米的營收差距已縮小至約20萬至30萬元，公司預期今年下半年之後，2奈米將逐步成為最大出貨製程節點。
更先進節點也已開始產生營收。中砂表示，第二季1.4奈米或更先進節點已開始出貨，目前約占營收 1 %，相關產品早期即與客戶進行打樣，為後續風險試產做準備。
在市占率方面，中砂表示，2奈米 Diamond Disk市占率約為 80 %，1.4奈米或更先進節點目前取得的市占率也約在 80 %。相較之下，中砂2024年 CMP Diamond Disk全球市占率約35%，顯示公司在先進製程的市占率明顯高於整體市場水準，也反映其已成為製程升級週期中的主要供應商之一。
由於中砂在先進節點市占率已處於高檔，中砂下一階段的成長空間除了來自客戶擴大產能外，更將取決於能否在既有客戶中增加供應品項，以及提高高規格產品比重。

paras_en: August 12, 2026 (Optimization Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) - As TSMC's advanced process continues to advance with the introduction of A16, which features backside power supply technology, and the next-generation A14 platform, the complexity of the process is increasing, bringing new growth opportunities for semiconductor material suppliers. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (1560-TW) stated in its latest earnings report that the general N2 process has approximately 50 steps without the introduction of backside power supply, but with the introduction of A16 backside power supply, it increases to around 70 steps, showing that the demand for CMP-related materials is driven not only by wafer slicing volume but also by the increasing number of process steps required for a single wafer.

Therefore, the market will evaluate Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's DBU Diamond Business Unit (Diamond Business Unit) by observing TSMC's advanced process capacity and wafer slicing volume, as well as the number of CMP process steps required for a single wafer, which will become an important factor in determining Diamond Disk demand.

CMP is an important polishing process in wafer manufacturing, mainly using polishing pads and chemical polishing liquids to polish the wafer surface. However, the polishing pad will accumulate polishing residue over time, affecting the polishing effect, and therefore needs to be regularly maintained. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's main supply of Diamond Disk is responsible for 'reorganizing the polishing pad' material, using the surface's diamond particles to re-maintain the polishing pad and maintain its stable polishing ability.

In other words, Diamond Disk, although not directly in contact with the wafer for polishing, is an important material for maintaining the stability of the CMP process. When advanced processes require more CMP steps, the polishing pad usage frequency will increase, and the demand for Diamond Disk will also increase.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co stated that, from a process step perspective, the general N2 process without backside power supply has approximately '50 steps', while the A16 process with backside power supply increases to '70 steps'. The increase in CMP steps does not necessarily lead to a proportional increase in Diamond Disk usage, but the concept remains the same: as advanced processes continue to evolve, the complexity of the process steps required for a single wafer is increasing.

This also means that Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's growth momentum is no longer solely dependent on wafer slicing volume. Even if wafer slicing volume growth is limited, as long as each wafer requires more CMP steps, the demand for materials such as Diamond Disk will still increase.

For investors, the main variables affecting Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's Diamond Disk revenue growth include wafer slicing volume, single-wafer CMP process complexity, actual Diamond Disk usage intensity, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's market share at each process node. Among these, wafer slicing volume and CMP process complexity are synchronously increasing with the advancement of advanced processes.

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's second-quarter revenue for 2-nanometer and 1.6-nanometer processes grew by approximately 84% compared to the first quarter, mainly driven by customers' new factory capacity expansion. In the second quarter, 2-nanometer revenue accounted for 14%, and the revenue gap with 3-nanometer narrowed to around NT$200,000 to NT$300,000. The company expects 2-nanometer to become the largest shipment process node in the second half of the year.

More advanced nodes are also starting to generate revenue. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co stated that the second-quarter 1.4-nanometer or more advanced nodes have started shipping, accounting for around 1% of revenue, and related products have been early-stage sampling with customers to prepare for subsequent risk production.

In terms of market share, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co stated that the 2-nanometer Diamond Disk market share is around 80%, and the market share of 1.4-nanometer or more advanced nodes is also around 80%. Compared to the 35% global market share of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's CMP Diamond Disk in 2024, the company's market share in advanced processes is significantly higher than the overall market level, reflecting its status as a major supplier in the process upgrade cycle.

Due to Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's high market share in advanced nodes, the company's next stage of growth will depend not only on customers' expansion of production capacity but also on increasing the number of supply items for existing customers and increasing the proportion of high-specification products.
